prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / game sprite asset extraction.
Image 1 is the approved lobby navigation design. Create a production sprite sheet of ONLY its NEW background decorations, NOT the existing icons or labels. Match the warm dark walnut wood, very thin honey-gold top lip and glossy crisp lime-green leaves exactly.
Transparent background, landscape canvas 2048x1024, orthographic 2D UI artwork.
TOP SECTION: one exceptionally long horizontal wooden rail filling x32..2016, y80..320, perfectly rectangular with square cut sides. Continuous straight thin bright gold / amber beveled top edge about 14px high. Main body rich warm walnut horizontal restrained grain. Thin dark brown lower bevel. NO left or right gold rim, NO end caps, NO foliage attached to the rail. Uniform material across the whole width, no central emblems or holes. The wood must be fully opaque; surrounding canvas genuinely transparent. This long rail is designed to extend off screen on both sides, with its top and bottom detail suitable for 9-slice. No perspective.
LOWER SECTION separated by generous transparent gaps: at x80..420 y430..600 one small LEFT-edge decorative cluster of four glossy bright green broad leaves matching the upper-left leaves in approved design, dark outlines, no stem protruding down. At x560..900 y430..600 one complementary RIGHT-edge four leaf cluster. At x1040..1070 y430..620 one narrow carved walnut/honey-gold vertical separator, slender straight 8px shaft with tiny diamond node at middle, outlined dark brown like approved design. At x1250..1660 y470..600 one subtle soft amber oval platform light reflection / selected-menu glow for under an icon, low contrast and mostly transparent with a soft faded edge, no solid medallion or pedestal.
These are four separated cutout decorations below one rail, all completely inside their stated zones, no touching objects, no other elements. Do not draw any of the five menu icons, characters, items, exclamation dots, words, letters, Korean labels, arrows, rulers, or headings. Preserve texture and reference style. No mushroom/crystal ornaments. Actual alpha transparency.
postprocessing: Mechanical sprite sheet crop, alpha bounds and exact-size resize only.
